method: Exact course identifiers matched against official ORC index; catalog URLs normalized to lowercase because mixed case returned HTTP404.
Every HTTP response required success and exact course heading identity (or documented official EARS/EAPS renumbering).
Prerequisite/corequisite fields and descriptions inspected. Department major requirements were not treated as universal course prerequisites.
Explicit no-prerequisite statements only; absent fields remained unresolved.
Complex ambiguous conditions remained advisory, retaining independently verified mandatory coursework where applicable.
Recommended preparation separated from mandatory coursework. Coursework OR permission used waiver branches; ordinary registration permission remained advisory.
